text: The Art of World of Warcraft: Warlords of Draenor is an artbook pertaining to the Warlords of Draenor expansion. It was contained in the Warlords of Draenor Collector's Edition.
The Arcanite Bladebreaker unlocks the Arcanite Bladebreaker appearance for the Strom'kar, the Warbreaker artifact.
The Banishing of the Elemental Lords was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, found in the Scarlet Halls. However, it was removed prior to release.
The Annals of Light and Shadow are a series of 12 volumes that can be traded to Archivist Inkforge in Netherlight Temple for Writings of the End.
The Art of World of Warcraft: Legion is the artbook of Legion, obtained only through the Collector's Edition.
The Azerite Stuff took place at Twilight Shore and Nazj'vel in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.

The Battle for Argus Begins is the prologue cinematic for World of Warcraft Patch 7.3: Shadows of Argus. Although it is not considered to be the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0N2XcaMsmOU official trailer] for Patch 7.3 - which reuses both audio and visuals from other cinematics and cutscenes - it serves the same purpose as previous patch trailers nonetheless. It shows the Prophet Velen preparing to invade Argus via the Vindicaar, with Illidan Stormrage questioning his past decisions.
The Battle for Brennadam is a bonus objective while in Brennadam Square for Dousing the Flames, You Have Their Orders, and Bombs, Away.

The Assemblage of Houses is a small monument in Boralus's Unity Square, dedicated to continued cooperation between the various noble houses of Kul Tiras. The memorial itself consists of a large anchor (the traditional symbol of the Admiralty of Kul Tiras) above an inscribed plaque.
The Baron's Cannon is a cannon located next to Lil' Crazy Jerry in the Sorrowmurk in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is used to reach the Fortune's Fist during In With a Bang.
The Banshee's Wail Cannons are three cannons located on the Banshee's Wail in the Great Sea.
The Banewood is the bonus objective for the Banewood in southern Revendreth.
The Archon is a scroll found at the Vestibule of Eternity in the Vestibule of Eternity in Bastion.
The Art of World of Warcraft: Shadowlands is the collection of concept art, sketches, CGI images, and otherwise that came with the World of Warcraft: Shadowlands Collector's Edition.

The Angler and the Monks is a tome found in various places on Pandaria, including: *Sri-La Inn in the Jade Forest *a small camp by the hill west of the Imperial Granary in the Valley of the Four Winds *Krasarang Wilds *Kun-Lai Summit *Dread Wastes *Veiled Stair *Vale of Eternal Blossoms

__NOTOC__ The Ark of Ssslith is found in the Bloodscale Enclave in Zangarmarsh. Fhwoor, escorted by an adventurer, retrieved it from the naga encampment and placed it in Sporeggar. They also killed the owner of the urn, Ssslith.
The Archivists' Catalog is a quest reward from Beginning the Collection and can be purchased from Archivist Roh-Suir for .

The Archivists' Codex is awarded to players who turn in enough Relic Fragment-granting items to Archivist Roh-Suir at Keeper's Respite in Korthia, and reach (exalted) with the Archivists' Codex faction.
The Azure Vault is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Umbrelskul in The Azure Vault.
.]] The Anniversary Pack was a bundle of eight mounts and four companions available for $79.99 from the Battle.net Shop and the In-Game Store. The bundle is available from 17 to 28 November 2022.
The Basecamp Pets is available at Renown level 11 with the Dragonscale Expedition.
The Battlespoon is currently unavailable but may show up in the future as a Trading Post item.
"The Book of Ur" is a book written by the mage Ur of Dalaran. It came later into the hands of archmage Arugal, and was available as an in-game book.

"The Birth of the Lich King" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter IV. It is set immediately following the events of Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal. Found at: * Reliquary of Scholomance in the Western Plaguelands * Southshore Inn in the Hillsbrad Foothills * The Scarlet Bastion (live side) of Stratholme * The Darkshire town hall in Duskwood, next to Lord Ello Ebonlocke Timeline: * ← Previous book: The Invasion of Draenor * → Next book: Icecrown and the Frozen Throne
The Befouled Element is the 1st quest in The Befouled Element quest chain.
The Black Stalker is the final boss of The Underbog wing in Coilfang Reservoir.

The Big Bad Wolf is a worgen boss in the Opera House in Karazhan. He drops the rare pet Spiky Collar, part of Raiding with Leashes II: Attunement Edition. He can also be found backstage in Return to Karazhan standing next to Grandmother.
The Black Bride is a Forsaken Arathi Basin battlemaster located at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
__NOTOC__ The Bigger One is crafted with Engineering (325); taught by Goblin Engineering trainers. 3 of The Bigger One are constructed per combine.
The Blood Elves is an Alliance-only quest in the draenei starting zone Ammen Vale, in which players must eliminate a group of blood elves who followed the draenei from Outland.
__NOTOC__ The Black Stalk drops from The Black Stalker in the Underbog on heroic mode.
The Bladespire Threat is the 1st quest in the The Bladespire Threat quest chain.
It drops most commonly from the Enormous Bullfrog in Razorfen Kraul.
The Blackrock Slicer is a Level 55 quality Two-Handed Axe that has a chance on hit to cause a bleed effect.

The Broken Isles is chapter 2 of the Terror of the Tides campaign. It was an engagement fought between Maiev Shadowsong's Sentinels and Illidan Stormrage's Naga, in the wake of Illidan's escape from Kalimdor and his raid upon the Tomb of Sargeras.
The Broken Sigil is the third step in the long Trol'kalar quest chain.
The Blood-Tempered Ranseur is the final part of the The Second Trial quest chain for blood elf paladins.
.]] The Beast Within is a Beast Mastery hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.
The Bitter Taste of Victory is the twelfth and final mission of the Alliance campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.
The Borderlands is the second mission of the Orc campaign in Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. In this battle, the orcs defend the Borderlands from the humans of Stormwind.
The Blessing of Zim'Rhuk is a buff that provides excellent mana reneration (91/ 5 sec).
This quest makes available No Mercy! (PvP daily), ...All the Help We Can Get., and Your Attention, Please.
The Brewfest Diet is related to the seasonal event Brewfest. Completing this achievement is also an objective of the meta achievement Brewmaster (achievement).
The Blightbringer was one of the two Forsaken battleships that landed on the beach on the Strand of the Ancients. From the defending Alliance's point of view it was the boat on the right.
The Big Gun is a siege weapon on the Sister Mercy. It is more of a turret, being unable to move apart from rotating.

The Black Knight's Fall concludes the secondary quest chain of the Argent Tournament starting with either The Black Knight of Westfall? or The Black Knight of Silverpine? Players are required to reach the rank of Champion by completing A Champion Rises before Crusader Rhydalla will offer this quest.
The Blood Furnace is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Blood Furnace instance on normal or heroic difficulty.
The Botanica is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Botanica instance on normal or heroic difficulty.
The Black Temple is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Black Temple instance.
The Brave's Machete is provided as an objective by Winterhoof Brave for Gruesome, But Necessary (Horde).
The Black Knight's Curse continues The Black Knight quest chain, starting in Patch 3.2.0. Players are not required to have acquired the title in order to be eligible for this quest.
The Bread Winner is a quest achievement earned for making gold from quest rewards.
The Breath of Alexstrasza is provided for The Boon of Alexstrasza.

The Breath of Har'koa is a buff given by Har'koa on completion of the quest Preparations for the Underworld. It is applied for 10 seconds, then vanishes again. The buff itself is not important; it flags you for a variety of phase change at the Altar of Quetz'lun. Until you complete the quest chain, when you approach the altar of Quetz'lun you will "leave your material body behind", moving into the 'underworld' (with the buff Ghostly). The world will appear in the monotones used when you are a ghost. This is similar to the effect of the Bash'ir Phasing Device.

The Briny Cutter is a name of an Alliance ship that sinks to the bottom of the Kelp'thar Forest in an area called Seafarer's Tomb. Shortly after the sinking, Erunak Stonespeaker saves the adventurer's life and tasks them with various quests. Eventually Captain Taylor is phased in as a survivor and assumes leadership.
The Brain of the Unfathomable drops, at first, from Ick'thys the Unfathomable and is later provided as an objective for Communing with the Ancient.
The Blood of Mannoroth is an interlude in the Invasion of Kalimdor campaign.

:Were you looking for the Warcraft III building called the Boneyard? The Boneyard is a contested subzone of the Twilight Highlands zone. It is around the rim of the Crucible of Carnage, and the fights can be previewed here. A Wildhammer settlement and a Dragonmaw settlement are located here.

Recover the following tol'vir artifacts that tell of the rise and fall of Emperor Ninjter: *Cat Statue with Emerald Eyes *Tiny Oasis Mosaic *Sketch of a Desert Palace *Soapstone Scarab Necklace *Engraved Scimitar Hilt *Canopic Jar One must have a minimum Archaeology skill of 450 to acquire the archaeology fragments needed to complete these artifacts.
The Big Big Book o' Beards is contained in Treasures from Grim Batol, a quest reward from Soften them Up.
#The Burning Blade (quest) #The Dranosh'ar Blockade (quest) #Fizzled #Margoz (quest) #Skull Rock (quest) #Arnak Fireblade (quest) #Ak'Zeloth (quest)

The Black Bishop is a human affiliated with the Twilight's Hammer. He plays a role in the Twilight Highlands story beginning. He is insane to the point of when he speaks, he talks as if he is playing chess, calling the player a pawn.

__NOTOC__ The Beast Unleashed is a faceless one, a corrupted, twisted monster that Grundy MacGraff transforms into during the wedding of Fanny Thundermar and Keegan Firebeard within Kirthaven in the Twilight Highlands. Grundy heard the whisperings from the Maw of Madness before the wedding, though no one took note, and it appears that this fall into the darkness.
The Bitter Pill is provided as an objective for A Bitter Pill. It is a very large bomb that you use to blow the head off of a very large worm.
The title The Bloodthirsty is awarded to players upon completing the achievement 250000 Honorable Kills.
The Burning Corridor is an area within the Bastion of Twilight.
The Buddy System is a PvP guild achievement requiring the guild members to win 500 ranked arena matches while in a guild group.
The Black Temple Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the The Black Temple raid while in a guild group.

The Birthplace of Liu Lang is a wood-panel scroll found outside leaning against a basket on the northeast side of Stone Mug Tavern in Stoneplow, Valley of the Four Winds Interacting with the scroll is an objective of the Pandaria exploration achievement Ballad of Liu Lang.

The Broken Hearted is an Pandaria archaeology achievement gained by discovering each of the following Pandaren artifacts dealing with Yao Firmpaw and his lost love, a Lorewalker named Lin. *Carved Bronze Mirror *Gold-Inlaid Figurine *Apothecary Tins
the Beloved is a title rewarded for obtaining 60 Exalted Reputations. The title will show after the character's name, in the following format: : the Beloved
The Bilgewater Molotov is provided as an objective for Flash! Aaaaaahhhh!

The Burdens of Shaohao is a series of six animated shorts depicting the trials of Emperor Shaohao in the days before the Great Sundering. The series is narrated by Lorewalker Cho. It is also featured in the official sites as part of the Destination: Pandaria literature.
The Bone Crawler is a rare level 101 rockworm found in the Refuse Pit of Frostfire Ridge.
When used, all garrison plans for tier 1 and tier 2 buildings will be learnerd.
The Black Hand is a smoldering slag hammer that was wielded by Warlord Blackhand and used to forge weapons of peerless quality. Such a weapon is forged perhaps once a generation.

The Brass Compass is about locating and looting a Strange Brass Compass and killing the end boss Skulloc in Iron Docks. To Receive the quest you need to have built an Lunarfall Inn/Frostwall Tavern in your Garrison and wait for Fleet Master Seahorn to spawn. Is part of the Stay Awhile and Listen Achievement. Next time Fleet Master Seahorn visits your inn/tavern he will offer the daily quest The Search Continues (Draenor) if you already completed The Brass Compass.
__NOTOC__ The Blackfang is the saberon leader of the Blackfang tribe, located at Fang'rila in the Tanaan Jungle.
The Bone Collector is a Garrison buildings achievement. The Gladiator's Sanctum building is required.
The Burninator is a goblin shredder located at the Ring of Trials in .
The Brood Queen's Veil is a quest reward from The Keystone (quest).
The Bore is a cave located just west of in Tanaan Jungle. Felbore can be found working the walls in here.
The Blades of Vengeance is Dave Murphy's gyrocopter located at the Weeping Bluffs in Stormheim.

:"Has 20 years of training in classical ballet, but ALLLLLL he ever gets asked to do is boogie." :— Flavor text The Boogeymonster is an unidentified creature who appears in the Whispers of the Old Gods expansion for Hearthstone. It was created by the Old Gods.
The Boomshirt is a quest reward from Master Boom Boom (quest). To complete the quest, you must successfully challenge Master Boom Boom.
The Bonereaper's Hook unlocks the hidden appearance for Apocalypse, the artifact weapon for Unholy death knights.
The Broken Hook was never made available, and its ID was reused for Water Stone. It would have provided an alternate appearance for the Underlight Angler.
The Bilgewater Bargain is a carrier located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Blightcaller is a carrier located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

The Bradensbrook Investigation may refer to: *Holy: The Bradensbrook Investigation (paladin) *Holy: The Bradensbrook Investigation (priest) *Mistweaver: The Bradensbrook Investigation *Restoration: The Bradensbrook Investigation (druid) *Restoration: The Bradensbrook Investigation (shaman)
The Bloody Scimitar was a cursed pirate battleship. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
The Briny Expedition is a submarine located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Burning Black Beverage is sold by Master Talekeeps in the following dive bars for :
The Blood-Thane's Amulet is a quest reward from What the Bonespeakers Buried.
The Bones of Xibala is an optional breadcrumb to Xibala, requiring The King's Gambit, although the next quests can be started at any point before.

The BlizzCon Book: A Celebration of Our Community is the BlizzCon 2018 promotional item, exclusive to those who purchase the event's "goodie bag." It features a forward by Mike Morhaime, and is a retrospective look on the history of BlizzCon, from 2005 to 2017.
__NOTOC__ The Brue is a honey elemental ooze that appears after interacting with a Mead Barrel in the cellar of Mildenhall Meadery in Stormsong Valley.
The Blackfish is an orca located at the southwesternmost point of the Abandoned Reef in the Abyssal Depths. It is part of the Riddle of the Hivemind.
The Black Arrow is a Forsaken battleship that is used by the Horde to begin their assault at the Ruins of Auberdine during the Battle for Darkshore.
The Bloodied Glaive of Vol'jin is the objective of Justice for the Fallen and Wisdom of the Warchief.
The Blade of Kroga was to be an objective of Preying on Predators.
The Bonebreaker was the nickname given to a female assassin who, after one of her victims came back from the dead, developed a habit of breaking their legs after killing them.
The Brewmaiden is a dwarf ghost summoned by the following items: *Brightbrew Charm *Bubbling Brightbrew Charm *Bubbliest Brightbrew Charm *Bubblier Brightbrew Charm
The Black Brewmaiden is a Dark Iron dwarf ghost summoned by the following items: *Balebrew Charm *Bitter Balebrew Charm *Bitterer Balebrew Charm *Bitterest Balebrew Charm
The Best of Us is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating Queen Azshara in The Eternal Palace with one player still alive who is currently affected by Essence of Azeroth
The Brand's Key drops from Brethlun the Brand in the Maw. __NOTOC__
The Biggest Rock You Can Find is found in the Challenger's Promenade in Maldraxxus.

]] The Box of Many Things is offered by the broker Ve'nish, found somewhere inside Torghast. Finding Ve'nish and completing this quest is the prerequisite to unlock the The Box of Many Things mechanic, which is a form of meta-progression in Torghast added in patch 9.1. Ve'nish can be found on floor two of any layer, so if players are specifically looking for this quest, knock out a layer one run.

The Broken Crown begins "Crown of Wills", the fifth chapter of the Zereth Mortis campaign. It chronologically takes place after the first eight boss encounters of the Sepulcher of the First Ones raid, but does not require any raid progress to access.
The Blue Dragon Oathstone concludes the "Vakthros" chapter of the Azure Span storyline, and of the zone storyline itself. The Thaldraszus storyline begins with To Valdrakken, from Kalecgos.
The Best at What I Do is a reputation achievement earned by killing 30 bosses in Grand Hunts.
The Bitter End becomes available after the next weekly reset after completing Pain Management.
__NOTOC__ The Blubberwall is a tuskarr located at Imbu in the Azure Span. He is the chieftain of Imbu. He also fights against the Zaqali djaradin at Suffusion Camp: Frostburn.
The Burden of Lapisagos is found in the Spellsworn Missive on a table at / in the Earth-Warder's Cauldron of the War Creche in Forbidden Reach. This is one of the criteria of Librarian of the Reach.
The Breadth of Dragon Weaponry becomes available after reaching Renown 29 with the Valdrakken Accord.
The Binder's Bonds drops from: *Bonespeaker Runeaxe *Runeaxe Initiate *Bonespeaker Inkbinder *Kottr Vondyr

The Blacksmith and the Apprentice is the quest reward from A Key Story, given by Weaponsmith Koref in the Obsidian Enclave of Valdrakken on day eight of Secrets of Azeroth. It reads: ]] The Cloverwood Hollow is in central Ohn'ahran Plains, marked on the zone map, southeast of Maruukai. In a ruined building in the Sylvan Glade, equip the Torch of Pyrreth and look for a Hastily Scrawled Stone at on the ground by a broken table. It reads: Re-equip the Tricked-Out Thinking Cap to reset it to (0, 0), then navigate to (-3, -2), or to find an Ancient Key Mold hidden in the leaves. Interact with it to pick up the Titan Key Mold, which starts A Titanic Mold.
The Coastal Menace is the third quest given by the ghost of Captain Grayson, in which you will be tasked with slaying the Murloc leader, Old Murk-Eye.
The Corruption Abroad is the 1st quest in the The Corruption Abroad quest chain.
The Castigator is a high dps one-handed mace, designed for use by rogues and warriors.
The Corpulent One is a quest where the player must find and slay on behalf of and the Argent Crusade.
__NOTOC__ The Collector's Ring drops from Morgan the Collector in Elwynn Forest. It was given to him by Edwin VanCleef.
The Captain's Chest was stolen by a giant and he wants it back!

This quest concludes the Green Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Players must also complete the Blue Scepter Shard and Red Scepter Shard forks before will offer the conclusion of the quest chain.
This quest concludes the introduction to The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

The Butchery is located inside the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It is where those captives who were unworthy of sacrifice were unceremoniously killed, their meat fed to the Atal'ai's serpent pets. The Butchery is a dead-end room connected to the Hall of Masks, the Den of the Caller, and the Chamber of Blood via narrow passages.
The Collector's Schedule is provided as an objective for The Collector (retail) or The Collector (Classic) (Classic).
The Cleaner is a black level 63 elite demon. Although he looks like a black dreadlord he appears not to be one.
The Butcher is a world drop item; it can be dropped by mobs in the Scarlet Monastery and the Scarlet Halls in Tirisfal Glades.
The Center of the Human Lands is the tenth mission of the Orc campaign in Warcraft: Orcs & Humans.

The Conflagration can be found at Corp'rethar: The Horror Gate in Icecrown. It is the site where the Lich King's elite soldiers have formed up to defend the Citadel and it seems to thank its name to the large blue flames in front of the gate. Thassarian or Koltira Deathweaver send the player to weaken the Lich King's forces by dissolving the corpses of the Skeletal Reavers thus making it easier for the upcoming main assault to reach the last line of defense: Corp'rethar.

The Conquest Pit: Bear Wrestling is part of the The Conquest Pit chain in Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills. It is similar to the Ring of Blood quests in Nagrand. A prot tank and a healing class can duo this fight, but 3 to 5 makes it very easy.
The Conjurer's Slippers drops from Mage-Lord Urom in the Oculus on normal mode.
The Coin Master is an achievement for fishing all the coins from the Northrend version of Dalaran fountain in the Eventide.

The Conqueror is a meta PvP achievement earned for gaining status with the Frostwolf Clan, the Defilers, and the Warsong Outriders through battles in Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, and Alterac Valley. This achievement rewards the title Conqueror.
The Casket Carrier was one of the two Forsaken battleships that landed on the beach on the Strand of the Ancients. From the defending Alliance's point of view it was the boat on the left.

World of Warcraft: The Comic Volume 3 is the third hardcover compilation of the World of Warcraft comic series. It contains the following issues: *Issue 15 - Conflicting Loyalties *Issue 16 - Threat! *Issue 17 - Gathering Thunder! *Issue 18 - Showdown! *Issue 19 - The Winds of War *Issue 20 - Repercussions *Issue 21 - Secrets In addition to the Wildstorm version, a [http://www.amazon.com/World-Warcraft-v-Walter-Simonson/dp/1848566042/ref=tmm_hrd_title_1 Titan Comics version] was published in August 2010 and a [http://www.amazon.com/World-Warcraft-Walter-Louise-Simonson/dp/1401228119/ref=tmm_pap_title_0 softcover version] was published in March 2011.
The Cake Is Not A Lie is a cooking achievement for baking a , one of the required achievements for the title, from completing the meta-achievement Hail to the Chef.

The Cinematic Art of World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King was cinematic artbook published for World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King. This book was later revised and published in 2012. A collector's edition hardcover was available during BlizzCon 2008. It also includes a small booklet entitled "The Fall of Sindragosa".
Defeat Horgrenn Hellcleave inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward. *Horgrenn Hellcleave defeated *Suggested Players [3]
The Construct Quarter (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the bosses in the Construct Quarter of Naxxramas on 10-player mode.

The Celestial Defender is the title associated with the achievement Realm First! Celestial Defender, being the first raid on a realm to defeat Algalon the Observer. The title comes after the character's name, in the following format: : the Celestial Defender

World of Warcraft: The Comic Volume 4 is the fourth hardcover compilation of the World of Warcraft comic series. It contains the following issues: *Issue 22 - Whispers *Issue 23 - The Gathering *Issue 24 - Hard Choices *Issue 25 - Armageddon *Special Issue 1 - Beginnings and Ends
The Burning Litanies is found at Ascendant's Rise in Mount Hyjal.
The Chef is a Forsaken cooking trainer located in Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

The Cataclysmic Gourmet is one of the Cooking-achievements added in Cataclysm. It asks the player to cook up various recipes added in the same expansion. Due to the slow accumulation of Chef's Award, which is used to buy the recipes, this achievement will take some time to complete.
The title the Camel-Hoarder is awarded to players upon completing the achievement Scourer of the Eternal Sands.
The Corpseburner's Flare is provided for Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee....
The Codex of Xerrath is created by combining the Sealed Tome of the Lost Legion with a Healthstone. It is the beginning of the quest line for warlocks to get green fire effects for specific spells.

The Burning Crusade Townhall is a source of Warcraft lore. It served as the first official page explaining the lore behind the two races added to the game during The Burning Crusade expansion. Formerly located at http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/burningcrusade/townhall/, it did not survive the official site overhaul of the World of Warcraft Official Website. Online transcriptions can be found at [http://www.serwerwrotapiekla.yoyo.pl/index.html], [http://web.archive.org/web/20061225013519/http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/burningcrusade/townhall/index.html] and in the articles below.
"The Burning Legion" is the main theme of World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade, and was composed by Russell Brower.
The Conservator is an arcane golem summoned by Ariden to attack the death knight player in the Karazhan Catacombs during The Dark Riders (death knight).
the Commandojack is a title awarded upon completing the Garrison achievement Choppin' Even More Logs. The title appears after your character's name: : the Commandojack
The Candleking's Candlecoin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
__NOTOC__ The Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.

The Chronicle of Ages is a book found at the Temple of Five Dawns on the Wandering Isle. It contains lore about the monk artifacts. Contrary to the other artifact lore books, this one doesn't have a set author.
The Corruptor's Totem is a quest reward from The Demon's Trail.

The Burning Jewel of Sargeras is dropped by demon bosses summoned on the summoning platform of Dreadscar Rift. The summoning requires one player to have researched the class hall trait Demonic Offering in order to create the portal with the Ritual of Doom spell. Then, two other warlocks are needed to click the portal and complete the ritual.

The Codex of the Dead is a nathrezim record. An excerpt from it describes the Burning Legion's invasion of the aldrachi homeworld, and how the aldrachi and their champion, Toranaar, fought against the invaders.

The Council's Wisdom is a buff that grants a 5% bonus to experience and reputation gains while at the Broken Isles. It is granted to mage players who are wielding Ebonchill, by the following NPCs: * * * * * * *
The Counterspell is a carrier located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Command Center is a one-time quest that becomes available when the construction of the Command Center building is completed.

The Chosen is a Legion raid achievement earned from killing Helya in Trial of Valor on Mythic difficulty without failing the Test of the Chosen. The Test of the Chosen buff is granted when Odyn begins his intro before he's pulled, or when pulling Odyn. Remaining alive throughout the rest of the instance and killing Helya will grant the achievement. The Testament of the Valorous is mailed to you upon completion.

The Burning Throne is the lore quest that opens the way to the raid Antorus, the Burning Throne. This is the mainline version for those that have completed Seat of the Triumvirate: The Crest of Knowledge.
The Core Hammer is a battleship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

The Catacombs are a series of underground tunnels the stretch out for miles to miles. It is filled with underground creatures that include kobolds, furbolgs and trogg. It also has ancient an treasure buried underneath, guarded by dragons and earthen. The area is most likely located under Kalimdor. Tale of the Fox tells the story of Marin the Fox and his encounters underground.
The Chamber of Heart was available when you reached reputation with the Champions of Azeroth prior to patch 8.2.0. Note that you would NOT get any hint or introduction that you've unlocked it.
The Butcher's Apron drops from Hannval the Butcher in Stormheim.
The Cinematic Art of World of Warcraft: Volume I is an upcoming cinematic artbook based on World of Warcraft.

The Cat Pack was a bundle of 4 companions and 3 mounts that are available at a discount from the Blizzard Shop and the In-Game Store. The bundle was originally available from 19 December 2019 to 6 January 2020. The bundle became available again on 22 March 2022 and ended on 29 March.

The Corruptor's End is a quest achievement earned by completing the Black Empire Campaign storyline.
The Chamberlain's Tarnished Signet is a quest reward from I Don't Get My Hands Dirty.
The Coldridge Cataclysm was a planned scenario in Legion set in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

The Captive King concludes the initial Torghast storyline, as part of the overarching Shadowlands campaign. Players must next defeat Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria and complete Redemption for the Redeemer before Bolvar will reach out with the next quest, An Echo in the Darkness.
The Conqueror's Chain drops from Grrvrgull the Conqueror in Morheim in Stormheim.

The Countess is a venthyr who is the Harvester of Desire, bearer of the Medallion of Desire, and thus has authority over the Castle Ward and is in charge of the court, composed of all the noble houses of the venthyr. She resides in Redelav Tower, which can only be accessed by the adventurer through a mirror from Thornhill Manor, which is Theotar's former residence due to his being her "paramour". The only named venthyr nobles other than Duke Theotar and Madame Iza friendly to the adventurer are those found within Redelav Tower. The Cannon of Medicine is a tome found behind Brother Therold in Anglepoint Dockworkers in Tiragarde Sound.
The Cloud Serpent is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Caretaker was a venthyr and the former Harvester of Envy. The predecessor to the Tithelord, they were the 274th Caretaker. The Caretaker's Manor as named after them.

The Countess's Parasol is a toy item looted from the following tribute chests in the Ember Court: *The Countess' Tribute *The Countess' Substantial Tribute *The Countess' Trifling Tribute *The Countess' Extravagant Tribute

Credits for World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. This list is a combination of the in-game credits, viewable from the main menu, and the credits previously found on the official site (see external links). __TOC__
The Chains of Command begins "An Army of Bone and Steel", the fifth chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign, unlocked at :Renown 47.
The Cost of Death is a weekly quest with Ve'nari, trading 800 Stygia for 1000 points of standing with her.
The Countess's Best Friend is a level 60 Venthyr Covenant quest that becomes available after reaching Best Friend status with The Countess through the Ember Court.
The Count is a dredbat located at the Grand Palisade in Revendreth.
The Chieftain's Totem is provided as an objective for Distortions in Time.
The Clerk's Chain is a quest reward from Roland's Doom (quest).
The Count's Pendant teaches you how to summon The Count, a dredbat companion. This item is a reward for using 99 to activate The Count, who is found at the Grand Palisade in Revendreth.
The Chirpsnide Auto-Excre-Collector is provided by Harleen Chirpsnide for Explosive Excrement. It is used to collect the roc excrement from Rocdrop Scarabs and Rocdrop Pudgepin.

The Catalyst's Boon is offered to players in patch 10.1 who have already unlocked the Revival Catalyst Console. Instead of having to do group content each week in Revival Catalyst (quest), simply logging in is enough going forward to gain Catalyst Charges.

The Clarion Call begins the night elf heritage armor questline. It is automatically offered to night elf characters who are level 50 or above. It can also be started from the Sealed Kaldorei Scroll on a table inside the Stormwind Embassy. Finally, it can be accepted through Adventure Guide.
The Chief's Enforcer drops from Chief Ukorz Sandscalp in Zul'Farrak.

The World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade Soundtrack was composed and arranged by Russell Brower, Derek Duke and Matt Uelmen. It was released together with the collector's edition of the game. The soundtrack can also be purchased via iTunes.

The Captain's Booty is an achievement related to the world event Pirates' Day. Simply make it to the top of the auction house and bank of Booty Bay, speak with Dread Captain DeMeza and choose the gossip option "Here's to you, Dread Captain! Make me a pirate for the day." DeMeza will then buff players with Dread Corsair, making them an honorary member of the crew for 12 hours.
The Demon Soul is the second book of the War of the Ancients Trilogy novels.
The Deed to Southshore is located in The Reliquary room of Scholomance (in the northeast corner on a table).
The Demon Seed is the 3rd quest in the Neeru Fireblade quest chain.
The Darksoul is a plate Zandalar crafted set crafted by Blacksmithing.
The Defiler's Purpose is the Horde Arathi Basin set set for Druids or Rogues.
The Defiler's Will is the Horde Arathi Basin set set for Druids or Rogues.
The Defiler's Resolution is the Horde Arathi Basin set set for Warriors or Paladins.
The Defiler's Determination is the Horde Arathi Basin set set for Hunters or Shamans.
The Defiler's Fortitude is the Horde Arathi Basin set set for Hunters or Shamans.
The Defiler's Intent is the Horde Arathi Basin set set for Priests, Mages or Warlocks.
This is the first quest in the Defias Brotherhood quest chain.

The Den is the base of operations in the Valley of Trials, and is the starting camp for young orc adventurers. It is in the small southwest corner of Durotar. This is where nearly all the Valley of Trials quests are obtained. It contains basic class trainers and vendors, but no profession trainers. Inside the cave are several cages, used for holding hostile Captured Northwatch Scouts. At some point, the scouts were visited by Zekhan.

The Defias Traitor is a human quest giver found in front of the scout tower at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. He revealed the location of the Defias Hideout in exchange for his life after he was captured by the People's Militia while attempting to steal Farmer Saldean's wagon.

The Dawn of Chaos is a total conversion for Blizzard Entertainment's Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne, recreating the classic, but outdated, Warcraft: Orcs & Humans with updated graphics, a modified storyline, and a new hero system. The project is commonly referred to as DoC.

The Crone is a jungle troll boss in the Opera House in Karazhan, who follows Dorothee, Roar, Strawman, Tinhead, and Dorothee's pet Tito. She can be seen in the backstage during the Return to Karazhan.

This quest starts the Crown of Will quest chain. Basically, one of Lady Sylvanas' errand boys has found a way to break away from her control and avoid doing the task he was given. Of course, that can't be tolerated...
This is part of the main Blasted Lands quest chain, even though it involves going to Azshara.

The Cudgel of Kar'desh is obtained inside the heroic version of the Slave Pens in Coilfang Reservoir. Completing it requires the defeat of both Nightbane, inside Karazhan, and Gruul the Dragonkiller. The quest was originally required to gain attunement to Serpentshrine Cavern.
__NOTOC__ The Decapitator drops from Prince Malchezaar in Karazhan.
]] The Cruel Hand of Timmy is a Level 42 quality One-Hand Mace that has a chance on hit to temporarily lower all attributes of its target.
This is one of the Blasted Lands buff quests. It rewards characters with an elixir giving +25 agility for a period of 60 minutes.
The Darkstone Tablet contains the secret recipes of a brilliant dwarf alchemist.
The Dark Lady is chapter 3 of the Legacy of the Damned campaign. It was the first major battle of the Civil War in the Plaguelands.

The Culling is Chapter Six of The Scourge of Lordaeron. It was the slaughter of a large portion of the civilian population of Stratholme at the hands of Prince Arthas, who sought to prevent the spread of the Plague of Undeath at any cost necessary. This event also marked the (temporary) disbanding of the Silver Hand, as Uther the Lightbringer refused to follow the order of executing civilians. More importantly, the event marked Prince Arthas's first major step to becoming a death knight by slaughtering his own people.
The Crossing is a secret chapter of Curse of the Blood Elves. Moments after Kael and Vashj killed Kassan, Vashj reopened the portal that Kel'thuzad used to bring the Burning Legion into Azeroth.

The Crimson Veil is the flagship of the Bloodsail Buccaneers, and the middle of their three frigates docked at the Wild Shore on the Cape of Stranglethorn. It was originally captained by Fleet Master Firallon until his demise during an attack on Booty Bay. Though the town turned its cannons upon the ship, it survived the encounter and was eventually captured by Eliza Goreblade when the Bloodsail Buccaneers tried to stop her and her maddened crew. By the time of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, it was retaken by Fleet Admiral Tethys and later docked in Booty Bay. He used it to get the leader of the Uncrowned to the Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna, in order to take the Horizon's Edge, defeat
The Defense of Strahnbrad is Chapter One of the Human campaign, The Scourge of Lordaeron, in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos.
The Deed to Brill is located in the Laboratory room of Scholomance (halfway down and to the right).
The Deed to Caer Darrow is located in Scholomance in the Barov Family Vault next to Lord Alexei Barov.
The Deed to Tarren Mill is located in Scholomance in the room immediately following the Chamber of Summoning (on a table at the far right end).
The book The Decree of the Scourge can be found on the first floor of Acherus: The Ebon Hold near Highlord Darion Mograine.
The Death Knights of Acherus is a book found on the upper level of Acherus: The Ebon Hold. Its text changes several times as the player progresses through the death knight starting quests.

When any unit is killed, it will begin to decompose and the remains will slowly seep into the ground. Necrolytes are trained in the black arts, and can raise these fallen warriors if they can reach the corpse before it disappears into the earth forever.
The Dead Mines is the fourth mission of the Orc campaign in Warcraft: Orcs & Humans.
The Dead Rise as Quel'thalas Falls is the eleventh mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
The Crone's Bargain is part of The Sons of Hodir quest chain.
This quest takes the character to the new phase of Crusaders' Pinnacle (Justice Keep) for the first time.
The Dedicated Few (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the bosses, except the Four Horsemen, in Naxxramas with less than 9 people on 10-player mode.
The Defiler is a player vs. player achievement earned for exalting reputation with the Forsaken Defilers.
The Dapper Sapper was a player vs. player achievement earned for planting 100 seaforium charges which successfully damages a wall.
The Descent into Madness (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the bosses of the Descent into Madness area of Ulduar on 10-player mode.
The Culling of Time is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Infinite Corruptor in the Culling of Stratholme on Heroic difficulty.
The Culling of Stratholme is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the listed bosses in the Culling of Stratholme.
The Crimson Hall (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the bosses of The Crimson Hall in Icecrown Citadel on 10-player mode.
The Cranberry Chairs can be found around Bountiful Tables outside all major cities and most minor towns throughout Azeroth and Outland.
The Czar of Sporeggar is an achievement for reaching status with Sporeggar.
The Death of Hellscream is the final cinematic of the orc campaign The Invasion of Kalimdor. It features Grom Hellscream and Thrall facing off against Mannoroth.
This achievement requires completing 75,000 daily quests by guild members.
The Darkwood is a forest on the Tol Barad Peninsula that is infested with spiders. Silk glands can be gained from Broodmother spiders in the area, which can be used to make silk.
For The Damsel's (Bad) Luck, you simply have to kill 8 Bloodsail Corsairs in Booty Bay
__NOTOC__ The Demon Chain is a quest item used in The Demon Chain (quest).

This rogue-only quest is the seventh part of the chain to obtain the legendary dagger set Fangs of the Father. It is a simple travel quest directing the rogue back to Wrathion. It rewards the Jaws of Retribution, the first of two dagger sets that will be upgraded during the questline, ultimately becoming the Fangs of the Father.

The Defiant is a wood-panel scroll leaning on the corner base of a broken mogu statue, located at / the north end of the Dark Rookery of the Ancient Passage on The Veiled Stair. Interacting with the scroll is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Between a Saurok and a Hard Place.
